tagline: International representation body for European inland waterway transport and maritime interests
hero_kpi_rationale: En tant qu'association internationale de représentation fondée en 1877, l'IVR mesure son impact par la participation aux événements clés. La participation au congrès annuel reflète l'engagement des membres, la couverture sectorielle et l'influence organisationnelle dans la navigation intérieure européenne.

kpis.explanation: Total number of participants at the annual congress representing membership engagement and pan-European sector representation.
kpis.signal: Strong growth in congress participation reflecting increased member engagement and organizational influence across European inland shipping sector
kpis.description: 225 participants from 11 different countries attended the IVR Annual Congress in Frankfurt am Main from May 15-17, 2024, compared to approximately 207 in 2023. The congress included board meetings, workshops on navigating the future of inland waterways, and general assembly sessions.

kpis.name_fr: Participants au colloque de prévention des sinistres
kpis.explanation: Number of participants at the inaugural Loss Prevention Colloquium, a major knowledge-sharing initiative on technical and financial aspects of loss prevention in European inland shipping.
kpis.signal: Successful launch of new industry knowledge-sharing platform covering loss prevention in European inland navigation sector across multiple countries
kpis.description: First edition of the Loss Prevention Colloquium held November 4, 2024 in Antwerp, Belgium, attracting approximately 80 participants from Belgium, Netherlands, and Germany. Eight presentations across three sessions covered technical regulations, decarbonization impacts, engine day values, classification society roles, quality/quantity losses, greening challenges, harbor resilience, and clean shipping solutions.

kpis.explanation: New technical guidance documents and recommendations issued to standardize and inform the inland shipping industry on current topics.
kpis.signal: Continuous contribution to technical standardization and regulatory harmonization across Europe through CESNI committees and Central Commission for Rhine Navigation participation
kpis.description: Multiple new technical guidance documents and sheets issued throughout 2024 covering professional qualification standards, digitalization in inland shipping, decarbonization and greening initiatives, and clean shipping solutions. Published in coordination with CESNI (European Committee for the Development of Standards in Inland Navigation) and ZKR (Central Commission for Rhine Navigation).

company_description: Ubisoft Entertainment SA produces, publishes, distributes, and operates video games for consoles, PC, smartphones, and tablets in both physical and digital formats in Europe, North America, and internationally. The company designs and develops software, including scenarios, animation, gameplay, layouts, and game rules, as well as develops design tools and game engines. Ubisoft Entertainment SA was founded in 1986 and is headquartered in Saint-Mandé, France.

description.long_fr: Ubisoft est un éditeur français de jeux vidéo. Le groupe développe et édite des franchises mondiales comme Assassin's Creed, Far Cry, Tom Clancy's (Rainbow Six, The Division, Ghost Recon), Just Dance, Watch Dogs et Rayman. Le groupe exploite également des services live et abonnement (Ubisoft+). Chiffre d'affaires 2023-2024 : ~2.32 Mds €.
description.long_en: Ubisoft is a French video game publisher. The group develops and publishes global franchises such as Assassin's Creed, Far Cry, Tom Clancy's (Rainbow Six, The Division, Ghost Recon), Just Dance, Watch Dogs and Rayman. The group also operates live services and subscriptions (Ubisoft+). 2023-2024 revenue: ~€2.32 bn.
description.long_de: Ubisoft ist ein französischer Publisher von Videospielen. Der Konzern entwickelt und veröffentlicht globale Franchise‑Marken wie Assassin’s Creed, Far Cry, Tom Clancy’s (Rainbow Six, The Division, Ghost Recon), Just Dance, Watch Dogs und Rayman. Zudem betreibt das Unternehmen Live‑Services und ein Abonnement‑Modell (Ubisoft+). Konzernumsatz 2023‑2024: ~2,32 Mrd. €.
